snippet.title: Backyard Monsters Wild Monster Invasion Event Wave 1-30 +1
snippet.description:
Watch Backyard Monsters Wild Monster Invasion Wave 32 (Bonus Wave 2): http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ytAfPartVYw

SPOILER ALERT!!!

Judgment day in monster city!

There is but one question. Will the Town Hall make it to the end? Find out...

Notes:
This is my humble yard. Tweaked many, many times. But the layout stayed the same from the start of BYM play.

For waves 1-4 and the higher waves, forgive the heavy lag.  Game wasn't running on 8-core, or 4-core even. My computer couldn't handle the sheer number of monsters. And wave 5 is missing, file corrupted.

Also, please notice that my towers are far from their upgrade limits. Consider the greater advantage had all been upgraded and fortified to maximum. Here are my towers and stats:

2x lv 9 snipers, 1x lv 6 and 3x lv 7
lv 3, lv 4 and lv 5 teslas
3x lv 4 lasers
6x lv 6 cannons
2x lv 3 railguns
lv 5 and lv 6 air defense towers
4x lv 3 bunkers
champion level 5

1 tesla fortified to max
town hall fortified to 3
1x silo fortified to 1, 5x silo fortified to 0
remaining towers fortified to level 1 or 2 at most
